subject: Media Literacy
title: Media Literacy as Ad Defense
description: A micro-lesson that makes Media Literacy as Ad Defense usable.

hook.text: Finland teaches advertising literacy in elementary school. Their citizens are among the least manipulated consumers in the world.

buildup.text: Understanding advertising techniques is the most effective long-term defense against manipulation.

discovery.text: Research shows that labeling persuasion techniques activates critical thinking and reduces their effectiveness.

twist.text: Most education systems teach math and reading but never teach students how to analyze a commercial.

climax.text: We spend years learning to read text but zero time learning to read the persuasion built into media.

punchline.text: Name the trick and it loses half its power.

quiz.question: How does understanding ad techniques help consumers?
options: Labeling persuasion techniques activates critical thinking
